original_intent: Export authoritative non-trigger Unity contacts, two-consecutive-fixed-step support_v1 edges, and exactly-once macro events using lifetime-stable participants, frozen taxonomy/order, aggregate bounds, typed invalid-shot failures, and authoritative callbacks without changing protected roots.
desired_outcome: The focused Todo 3 EditMode suite passes twice from final source and directly proves every Todo 3 acceptance class, while source conforms to the frozen Todo 1 contact/support/event/failure contract and leaves canonical project and production player byte-identical.
user_outcome_review: The two fresh focused XML receipts genuinely pass 7/7, and several prior source defects are fixed. The artifact still does not satisfy the requested outcome: clear and fail coexist, support can persist across reversed vertical ordering, sorted events retain callback-order sequences, overflow failure kinds are not the frozen envelope codes, and the focused tests omit or contradict required behavior.

verified_fixes.stable_lifetime_ids: Registry allocates per-instance spawn ordinals; static/no-body colliders use world:static IDs; runtime contacts/callbacks route through it.

verified_fixes.fixed_step_stability_source: FixedUpdate samples bodies and requires two equal candidates before transition recording.
verified_fixes.trigger_exclusion_and_collision_dedupe: Triggers are skipped and collisions dedupe per unordered pair/fixed step.

blockers.observation: Deduplication uses kind+subject, so level_cleared and level_failed have distinct keys and coexist. The focused test explicitly expects both.
UpdateSupport accepts absolute centre differences and chooses direction only from the current sample. Reversed ordering between consecutive samples incorrectly creates support.
AddEvent assigns Sequence at callback time and sorts afterward, so list order and sequence order diverge when callbacks arrive out of clock/taxonomy order.
Record and byte overflow collapse into PhysicalCaptureFailureCode.Overflow, so frozen record_limit_exceeded and byte_limit_exceeded kinds cannot be distinguished.
The 7-test suite lacks runtime ground/static registry-contact, authoritative stability-transition, and terminal-exclusivity assertions; its terminal test asserts forbidden coexistence.
